messages:
tara: quick flag - our deprecation notice email triggered a spike in v1 retry+batch behavior this morning. A few tenants hit quota alarms. We need a short-term patch (banner + soft-throttle) and a medium plan for migration UX.

zack: Can you share numbers? how big was the spike?

tara: gist: v1_rps_spike: tenant-zen  +420% for 18m, tenant-arc +95% for 12m, platform v1 share 9%->13% during window.

olga: For short-term: 1) show non-modal banner in Console explaining deprecation and recommend "Run compatibility probe"; 2) apply per-tenant soft-throttle (reduce v1 QPS by 25% if 5m spike > baseline*3). That buys ops room without hard errors.

min: Ops note: throttle rule should be gradual (25% -> 50% -> 75%) with 2m steps to avoid sudden client-side backoff storms. Also emit metric `compat.throttle.applied` with tenant + reason.

zack: Agree on gradual throttle. Also add a Circuit Breaker label so product can see which tenants had automated throttles.

tara: UX: Banner copy suggestion: "Heads-up: We've started sunsetting v1. We detected unusual v1 traffic from your integration — run a compatibility probe to preview v2 behavior or request a temporary grace period." Button: "Run probe" and secondary link "Request grace".

console-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/5102 - adds banner and a small compat panel to Tenant -> Activity. Preview internal link in PR.

olga: Telemetry: we need a new dashboard tile: 24h v1->v2 match% (rolling), v1 qps by tenant, and throttle history. Also alert if throttled tenants > 3 and combined throttle > 20% cluster capacity.

min: On billing: if probes or shadow runs execute, mark them `probe.free=true` by default for standard plans, enterprise handled case-by-case. Do not double-bill. We'll need Finance OK but tagging is quick.

zack: For migration UX long-term: auto-score (compatibility index), one-click probe, and a migration timeline UI that shows percent rollout, projected cost delta, and auto-rollback triggers. This mirrors previous notes but we should design minimal MVP now.

tara: Action short-term: olga -> deploy throttle rule + metrics (ETA 3h), console-bot -> land banner PR (ETA next deploy), min -> patch billing tags for probe (ETA 6h), zack -> draft migration MVP doc and wireframe (ETA EOD).

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for service=router config=compat-soft-throttle v=2027-01-12-canary by olga

min: Canary rolling. Note: throttle tag `compat.throttle.step` will be emitted. I'm also gating automatic throttle to tenants not on Dedicated for first pass to avoid surprising enterprise customers.

zack: Good call. Also make sure audit log entries for any automatic actions include actor=system and a rollback-safe flag.

tara: If probes show >6% divergence for a tenant, we'll open a migration triage and recommend either shim or engagement from Solutions Eng.

console-bot: banner PR merged to staging. Will include a link to the compatibility panel and the probe modal.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary success service=router config=compat-soft-throttle v=2027-01-12-canary

min: Live metrics after 1h: throttles applied to 4 tenants, overall platform v1 share stabilized back to 9.5%. No billing anomalies reported so far.

tara: Thanks team. We'll follow-up with migration MVP doc and schedule a quick working session for the console flows. Closing this short loop. :white_check_mark:
